question: Which syllables and solar names are placed in the private part and feet?
premises: Placement locations include the private part and feet
The syllables iṃ and aṃ are used
They are addressed to Bhāskara and Sūrya
inference: One places 'iṃ' to Bhāskara in the private part and 'aṃ' to Sūrya in the feet.
plain_english: In the private part place 'iṃ' to Bhāskara, and in the feet 'aṃ' to Sūrya.
